en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: The first version reads as old folk song; the second version (after the marker) sounds like a later addition naming Gotse Delchev, Yane Sandanski, Dame Gruev and Todor Aleksandrov. Guesses: 'ан'мки' as hanim ladies, 'кавурче' (unknown, perhaps 'little unbeliever'), 'Omile mi' as 'grows dear'; the marker line is copied as given in the source.

lines.cyr: доста оди, мамин Кољо, пустите планини,
lines.lat: dosta odi, mamin Koljo, pustite planini,
lines.en: you have roamed enough, mother's Koljo, the deserted mountains,

lines.cyr: пустите планини, Кољо, у рамни долини.
lines.lat: pustite planini, Koljo, u ramni dolini.
lines.en: the deserted mountains, Koljo, in the flat valleys.
Haven't you had your fill, Koljo,
Come on, I will marry you off, Koljo,
they do not come back, mother,
perhaps they will send me news.

lines.cyr: Абре Кољо, мамин Кољо, мамин комита,
lines.lat: Abre Koljo, mamin Koljo, mamin komita,
lines.en: Hey Koljo, mother's Koljo, mother's guerrilla,

lines.cyr: не наоде ли се, Кољо, по Пирин Планина,
lines.lat: ne naode li se, Koljo, po Pirin Planina,
lines.en: haven't you had enough, Koljo, of the Pirin mountain,

lines.cyr: не наносе ли се, Кољо, пушка малихера?
lines.lat: ne nanose li se, Koljo, puška malihera?
lines.en: haven't you carried enough, Koljo, a Mannlicher rifle?

lines.cyr: Не виде ли Гоце Делчев, Јане не сретна ли,
lines.lat: Ne vide li Goce Delčev, Jane ne sretna li,
lines.en: Did you not see Gotse Delchev, did you not meet Yane,

lines.cyr: не сретна ли Даме Груев, Тодор Александров,
lines.lat: ne sretna li Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov,
lines.en: did you not meet Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov,

lines.cyr: не сретна ли Даме Груев, Тодор Александров?
lines.lat: ne sretna li Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov?
lines.en: did you not meet Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov?

lines.cyr: Не си видов Гоце Делчев, Јане не си сретнав,
lines.lat: Ne si vidov Goce Delčev, Jane ne si sretnav,
lines.en: I did not see Gotse Delchev, I did not meet Yane,

lines.cyr: не си сретнав Даме Груев, Тодор Александров,
lines.lat: ne si sretnav Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov,
lines.en: I did not meet Dame Gruev, Todor Aleksandrov,

lines.cyr: тук' хајдучките полјани, песните им пеам.
lines.lat: tuk' hajdučkite poljani, pesnite im peam.
lines.en: only the outlaw meadows, I sing their songs.

lines.cyr: Омиле ми на срцето Пирин мили роден,
lines.lat: Omile mi na srceto Pirin mili roden,
lines.en: It grows dear to my heart, Pirin, my dear homeland,

lines.cyr: тој крај на тажни песни, тој крај прекрасен,
lines.lat: toj kraj na tažni pesni, toj kraj prekrasen,
lines.en: that land of sad songs, that wonderful land,
